sourceAudioPreprocessing.decodePolicy: Decode full excerpt once, cap30seconds, then slice decoded samples at fixed starts
sourceAudioPreprocessing.source: FMA 30-second excerpts; source excerpt offsets within original full recordings are not known
sourceAudioPreprocessing.randomness: Fixed non-overlapping windows; no random crop; numpy seed 20261003
sourceAudioPreprocessing.shortAudio: Nonempty windows only; repeatpad under source processor when shorter than 480000 samples; empty windows logged
sourceAudioPreprocessing.aggregation: L2 each projected clip; arithmetic mean across present clips; L2 track
sourceAudioPreprocessing.durationMeaning: Audio clip duration does not certify original recording duration
